⚠ Set up IP rotation (tap to choose)
✅ Airplane via system setting (tap for details)

IP rotation needs a way to actually toggle the cellular radio. Choose one:

1. OmniADB-Host (recommended) — a separate optional companion app. It runs a fixed airplane-mode command over the local ADB shell, so no assistant change, no root and no PC are needed.

2. Default digital assistant — works immediately with no extra app, but replaces Google Assistant.

Note: the one-time adb shell pm grant ... WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS command does NOT toggle the radio on Android 15 and later. It only lets the relay keep Wi-Fi up during the switch, and OmniADB-Host grants it automatically. It is not a third way to rotate.

On this device, writing the airplane setting really does toggle the radio, so no assistant is needed.\n\nIf a system update breaks that behavior, the relay detects it and falls back to the digital assistant. You can set that fallback up now if you want.

OmniADB-Host is a separate, optional companion app from the same developer. Install its APK, open it once to complete ADB pairing, then come back here — this button will show a ready state.\n\nIf you would rather not install it, choose \"Set as default assistant\" instead.

1. In Tailscale, keep THIS app included (not excluded).\n2. In Tailscale, EXCLUDE your SOCKS5 proxy app so it can use cellular.\n3. Start that proxy on the port above, listening on 127.0.0.1.

Address, ports and token are already filled in — paste and run. The token can toggle airplane mode remotely, so do not share it.\nWhile Tailscale is disconnected the address shows as <tailscale-ip> and refreshes automatically once connected.

Rotation changes the CELLULAR IP only. Your proxy must use cellular as its upstream, or the exit IP will not change even after the phone reconnects.

IP rotation is optional and needs ONE way to actually toggle the radio:
(a) OmniADB-Host (recommended) — a separate optional app that runs a fixed airplane-mode command over the local ADB shell. No assistant change, no root, no PC; the ADB private key never leaves that app.
(b) This app as the default digital assistant — reliable, but replaces Google Assistant.
(c) On older ROMs, writing the airplane setting also works.
Order: (a) → (c) → (b); every step verifies the radio.
On Android 15+, WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS alone is NOT a rotation method — it only keeps Wi-Fi up during the switch.

GET /status also reports OS internet validation (network), device-wide cellular data usage (data_usage) and the active backend (airplane_backend).

Works with any local SOCKS5 proxy bound to 127.0.0.1 — 5G Proxy Pro, Clash, v2rayNG, shadowsocks-android, etc.
